  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  MARCH 19, 2020

  An Emergency meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor McKeown at 3:00
  p.m., on Thursday, March 19, 2020, via teleconference pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20
  at http://primtime.bluejeans.com/am2/live-event/uukpvzaa

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Kevin McKeown
  Mayor Pro Tem Terry O’Day (arrived at 3:02 p.m.)
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich
  Councilmember Ana M. Jara
  Councilmember Greg Morena
  Councilmember Ted Winterer

  Also Present:  City Manager Rick Cole
  City Attorney Lane Dilg
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 3:00 p.m., with all
  members present except Mayor Pro Tem O’Day.

  EMERGENCY ORDER  Motion by Councilmember Himmelrich, seconded by Councilmember
  Davis, to approve that under Govt. Code section 54956.5(a)(1), Council
  Mayor Pro Tem O’Day  determine that an emergency exists. Under the same provision, an
  arrived at 3:02 p.m.  emergency is defined as a work stoppage, crippling activity, or other
  activity that severely impairs public health, safety, or both. COVID-19
  clearly meets the definition of emergency.

  The motion was approved by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Jara, Winterer, Davis, Himmelrich, Morena,
  Mayor Pro Tem O’Day, Mayor McKeown
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

  RESOLUTIONS:  11.A. Adoption of No. 11240 (CCS) entitled, “An Emergency
  LOCAL EMERGENCY  Resolution of the City Council of the City of Santa Monica Pursuant to
  Chapter 2.16 of the Santa Monica Municipal Code Ratifying the
  Proclamation of Existence of Local Emergency and Supplemental
  Proclamations thereto,” was presented.
  Recommended Action

  1  March 19, 2020
 DocuSign Envelope ID: B2727D06-4A10-49EB-A640-89891903CECD

  Staff recommends that Council adopt the attached resolution ratifying the
  Executive Order issued by the Director of Emergency Services declaring
  the existence of a local emergency in the City of Santa Monica, and the
  Revised First, Second, Third, Revised Fourth, and Revised Fifth
  Supplements to that Order, with all orders extended through April 30,
  2020.

  Councilmember Morena recused himself on the 2nd Supplemental to avoid
  any perceived possible conflict of interest with his family’s business on the
  Councilmember Morena  Pier.
  excused at 3:28 p.m.
  There were no members of the public present for this item.

  Motion by Councilmember Winterer, seconded by Councilmember Jara, to
  include the 2nd Supplemental Order (including the Pier) in the overall
  resolution approving everything involving the Emergency ordinances.

  AYES:  Councilmembers Himmelrich, Davis, Winterer, Jara,
  Mayor Pro Tem O’Day, Mayor McKeown
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: Councilmember Morena

  Motion by Councilmember Himmelrich, seconded by Councilmember Jara,
  to adopt and ratify the resolution. The motion was approved by the following
  Councilmember Morena  vote:
  returned at 3:31 p.m.
  AYES:  Councilmembers Jara, Winterer, Davis, Himmelrich, Morena,
  Mayor Pro Tem O’Day, Mayor McKeown
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

  COUNCILMEMBER  13.A. Request of Councilmember Davis that Council authorize up to
  DISCUSSION ITEMS:  $10,000 from the Council contingency account to Meals on Wheels to
  MEALS ON WHEELS  support the organization’s efforts in delivering meals to vulnerable
  seniors who are at great risk amid COVID-19, was presented.

  There were no members of the public present for this item.

  Motion by Councilmember Davis, seconded by Councilmember Jara, to
  approve the recommendation. The motion was approved by the following
  vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Jara, Winterer, Davis, Himmelrich, Morena,
  Mayor Pro Tem O’Day, Mayor McKeown
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

  2  March 19, 2020
 DocuSign Envelope ID: B2727D06-4A10-49EB-A640-89891903CECD

  WESTSIDE FOOD BANK  13.B. Request of Councilmember Davis that Council authorize up to
  $10,000 from the Council contingency account to the Westside Food
  Bank to support the organization’s efforts in distributing a high
  volume of food to people in need amid COVID-19, was presented.

  There were no members of the public present for this item.

  Motion by Councilmember Davis, seconded by Councilmember Winterer, to
  approve the recommendation.

  Councilmember Jara, proposed a friendly amendment to add that these
  services be provided to local residents, students, and those who work in Santa
  Monica, to the best of their ability. The motion was considered friendly by
  the maker and seconder.

  The motion, with the amendment was approved by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Morena, Himmelrich, Davis, Winterer, Jara,
  Mayor Pro Tem O’Day, Mayor McKeown
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 3:45 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Kevin McKeown
  City Clerk  Mayor

  3  March 19, 2020
